info.name: spectroscope REST API
info.description:
The whole REST surface of spectro-server — 75 endpoints in 19 folders, one per area.

Every request targets {{baseUrl}} = http://{{host}}:{{port}} — change host/port once in the collection variables to re-target everything.

The chat/run stream (/ws) and the PTY shell (/ws/shell) are WebSocket endpoints, origin-checked at handshake time. They are not REST and are not part of this collection.

## The fences, measured

Measured with curl from loopback against a live spectro-server built from this tree (port 8236, 2026-08-04). A browserless REST client (no Origin header) passes every fence as long as it connects to loopback and targets localhost/127.0.0.1 in the URL. GET /api/health is the one path deliberately left open.

| endpoint | fence | no Origin | localhost Origin | evil Origin | evil Host |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET /api/health | none | 200 | 200 | 200 | 200 |
| GET /api/sessions | host | 200 | 200 | 200 | 404 |
| GET /api/settings | host | 200 | 200 | 200 | 404 |
| GET /api/leveling | host+origin | 200 | 200 | 404 | 404 |
| POST /api/leveling/tick | host+origin | 200 | 200 | 404 | 404 |

Every fence refusal is a blank 404, never a 403, so a refused caller cannot fingerprint the server.

## Variables

- `{{host}}` = `localhost` — Server host. The host fences require localhost/127.0.0.1/::1 here — a LAN IP answers 404 on every host-fenced endpoint.
- `{{port}}` = `8080` — spectro-server port. 8080 is the default; change once to re-target every request.
- `{{baseUrl}}` = `http://{{host}}:{{port}}` — Composed base URL. Every request targets {{baseUrl}}.
- `{{sessionId}}` = `20260730-120000-abcdef12` — A stored session id, shape [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*. Take a real one from GET /api/sessions.
- `{{nodeId}}` = `node-1` — A fleet node id. Take a real one from GET /api/fleet.
- `{{skillPack}}` = `superpowers` — A pack folder from the catalogue rows of GET /api/skills — set only for a skill installed from the catalogue.
- `{{skillName}}` = `brainstorming` — A skill name from GET /api/skills — the folder, not the display name: a packed skill shows as <pack>:<skill> and its folder is the part after the colon.
- `{{bundleId}}` = `five-lines` — A starter-bundle id from GET /api/bundles: five-lines | fleet | multi-agent.
- `{{localModelId}}` = `qwen3-4b` — A built-in model id from GET /api/local-model/catalog: qwen3-1-7b | qwen3-4b | qwen2-5-coder-7b | qwen3-8b | vibethinker-3b.
- `{{imageFile}}` = `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef.png` — A content-addressed image name, [0-9a-f]{64}.(png|jpg|webp). Take a real one from a generate_image tool result.
- `{{transcriptPath}}` = `-Users-you-project/session.jsonl` — A Claude Code transcript path from GET /api/claude/transcripts.
- `{{workspaceFilePath}}` = `README.md` — Root-relative file path inside the workspace, for GET /api/file.
- `{{scaffoldDir}}` = `/tmp/spectro-scaffold` — An existing target folder for POST /api/bundles/{id}/scaffold.
- `{{exchangeId}}` = `1f2e3d4c-5b6a-4789-9abc-def012345678` — An LLM exchange id, UUID shape as the recorder mints it. Take a real one from GET /api/sessions/{id}/llm-wire/index.
- `{{actionId}}` = `0a1b2c3d-4e5f-4671-8899-aabbccddeeff` — A browser action id, UUID shape as the recorder mints it. Take a real one from GET /api/sessions/{id}/browser-wire/index.

## Handle with care

- **DELETE /api/sessions/{id}** — This really deletes the session, and it is the one destructive endpoint without an ORIGIN fence — the host fence and the id shape check are the guards, a foreign Origin from a local page is not refused here. Point it at a throwaway home before replaying the whole collection.
- **POST /api/local-model/download** — Downloads are gigabytes — do not include this in an automated replay.
- **POST /api/settings/env** — Writes ~/.spectro/.env. Only names on the writable allow-list are accepted.
- **DELETE /api/skills/{name}** — Deletion is permanent — the seeding ledger will not re-seed it.
- **DELETE /api/skills/{pack}/{name}** — Deletion is permanent — the seeding ledger will not re-seed it.
- **POST /api/skills/install** — Copies files into ~/.spectro/skills. It never overwrites; a taken name answers 409.
- **POST /api/pick-workspace** — Blocks until a human answers the dialog on the server machine — exclude it from automated replays.
- **POST /api/claude/transcripts/folders/open** — Opens a native file-manager window on the operator's screen.
- **POST /api/claude/transcripts/gists** — Spends the operator key — one model call per transcript that is not already current.
- **POST /api/fleet/nodes** — Requires the server to run with SPECTRO_ALLOW_SPAWN set AND a running hub — otherwise every answer is 404, by design.
- **POST /api/explain** — Spends the operator's API key on every call.
- **POST /api/analyze** — Spends the operator's API key on every call.
- **POST /api/stt/model/download** — Downloads ~488 MB — do not include this in an automated replay.

item.name: health & doctor
item.description: Reachability, the rolling server log, and the scheduler's job state.

request.description:
Health probe; always {"status":"ok"} — reachability IS the signal.

Fence: none — No origin gating.

Writes state: no

query.description: optional. byte cursor from the previous poll
optional. tail lines for the no-offset form, max 1000

request.description:
The rolling ~/.spectro/logs/spectroscope.log as tail + incremental deltas: {content, offset}. 256 KB response cap; rotation resets to a fresh tail.

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

Writes state: no

item.description: Skills of both roots (user + project): list, disable, delete.

request.description:
All skills of both roots (user ~/.spectro/skills + project <cwd>/.spectro/skills), disabled ones included: {skills:[{name,description,source,disabled}]}. Card 182 adds catalogue:[{id,name,pack,description,licence,repo,commit,files,bytes,installed}] — the vendored shelf POST /api/skills/install copies from. A build without the catalogue resource answers catalogue:[].

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

Flip the .disabled marker on a skill (user root wins when both roots carry it). 404 unknown.

Body: {disabled: boolean} — false re-enables.

item.name: disable / enable a skill inside a pack

request.description:
The two-segment form: a skill installed from the catalogue lives at <root>/<pack>/<skill> and the agent calls it <pack>:<skill>. The colon is a display name, not a path, so the pack travels as its own segment. Flip the .disabled marker (user root wins when both roots carry it). 404 unknown.

Body: {disabled: boolean} — false re-enables.

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: yes

Delete a USER-root skill for good (seeding ledger keeps it away). 409 for a project skill, 404 unknown. Traversal-guarded.

CAUTION: Deletion is permanent — the seeding ledger will not re-seed it.

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: yes

item.name: delete a skill inside a pack

request.description:
The two-segment form, for a skill installed from the catalogue. Deletes the USER-root copy for good; an emptied pack folder goes with it. 409 for a project skill, 404 unknown. Both segments are traversal-guarded.

CAUTION: Deletion is permanent — the seeding ledger will not re-seed it.

Fence: host+origin — Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.

Writes state: yes

Copy one skill from the bundled catalogue into ~/.spectro/skills: the whole leaf directory that holds SKILL.md, plus the pack's LICENSE and PROVENANCE.json and a generated spectro-install.json. The id is matched against the enumerated catalogue by string equality and is never resolved as a path. 400 no id, 404 unknown id, 409 name taken (user or project root), 413 over the ceiling. Answers {name,pack,files,bytes,licence,commit}.

Body: {skill: "<pack>/<name>"} — one of the ids from the catalogue rows of GET /api/skills.

CAUTION: Copies files into ~/.spectro/skills. It never overwrites; a taken name answers 409.

Fence: host+origin+json — Loopback fence plus Origin check, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.

Writes state: yes

item.name: workspace & files
item.description: The workspace tree, single-file preview, and the native folder chooser.

query.description: optional. the session whose resolved workspace to serve; absent = 409, there is no fallback; ignored under scope=prospective
optional. session (default) or prospective — the configured folder the first run will use, before any session exists

request.description:
That session's resolved workspace tree (dot-files and build/dep dirs hidden, depth 8, 2000-entry cap, honest truncated flag; a link out of the workspace is left out). 400 malformed session id or unknown scope, 404 no workspace folder, 409 no workspace resolved for this session. With scope=prospective: the folder a run started now would use, named by the server from the configured workspace and never by the caller (409 when none is configured).

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

query.description: required. root-relative, sandbox-checked
optional. the session whose resolved workspace holds the file; ignored under scope=prospective
optional. session (default) or prospective — the configured folder the first run will use, before any session exists

request.description:
One file for the preview pane, CSP-sandboxed. Real-path sandbox: no traversal and no symlink escape. 400 unknown scope, 404 outside/hidden/missing, 413 over caps (2 MB text / 25 MB image), 415 binary. With scope=prospective: the same file out of the folder a run started now would use, named by the server from the configured workspace and never by the caller (409 when none is configured) — the tree and the preview take the same two roots, decided by one rule.

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

Open the NATIVE macOS folder chooser on the server machine (blocks up to 120 s). 200 {path}, 204 cancel, 409 dialog already open, 501 non-macOS, 500 failure. Picks only — changes nothing.

CAUTION: Blocks until a human answers the dialog on the server machine — exclude it from automated replays.

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

item.description: Claude Code transcripts under ~/.claude/projects, for the import path.

request.description:
List *.jsonl Claude Code transcripts under ~/.claude/projects, newest first, capped at 300 rows. Answers {limitBytes, truncated, transcripts: [...]} — truncated says the row cap fired, limitBytes is the ceiling the content endpoint enforces. Absent store = empty list.

query.description: required. base-relative, canonicalized, .jsonl only

request.description:
One transcript's raw JSONL for the import path, streamed. 400 non-.jsonl, 404 outside base/missing, 413 over 128 MiB.

query.description: optional. base-relative, repeatable, at most 24 honoured

request.description:
What a bounded batch of listed transcripts contains, so the import dialog can label a row without reading the store. Answers {maxBatch, facts: [{path, models, workflowCalls, subagents, workflowAgents, language?, firstPrompt?}]}. Models are listed in the order they first spoke. subagents counts agent files directly in the session's sidecar folder and workflowAgents the ones in the workflow run dirs below it — different populations, counted apart, and counted fresh at ask time because the sidecar moves while the transcript sits still. Unknown facts are omitted rather than sent as a placeholder. At most 24 paths per call; a path outside the store, a non-.jsonl name and a missing file all yield no row.

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

item.name: which of a session's folders exist

query.description: required. base-relative, canonicalized, .jsonl only

request.description:
Which of a session's three folders (store, scratchpad, subagents) are really on disk, with their absolute paths: {folders:[{kind,path}]}. Asked per request rather than cached, because a scratchpad appears when a run makes one and a temp sweep takes it away again. Anything that is not a transcript in the store answers an empty list.

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

item.name: show one of them in the file manager

request.description:
Reveal one of a session's folders in the desktop file manager. The body names a transcript and a KIND; the server resolves the transcript through the same fence every read here uses and derives the folder itself, so no path off the wire is ever opened. Answers {result} — 'missing' covers an unknown kind and a path outside the store alike.

Body: what is one of store | scratchpad | subagents.

CAUTION: Opens a native file-manager window on the operator's screen.

Fence: host+json — Loopback fence, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.

Writes state: no

query.description: optional. the session transcript, store-relative

request.description:
The agents that ran beside a session, as a LISTING: one directory walk, not the thousands of file reads a full join would be. Bodies come one at a time from /content when a reader opens a row. Empty for a session that spawned nothing.

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

Writes state: no

Summarise transcripts and store the gists. Only the ones that need it: a path whose stored gist still matches the file stamp is skipped. {all: true} clears the store first and re-reads everything.

Body: {paths: [store-relative transcript paths], all: boolean} — all:true re-reads the lot.

CAUTION: Spends the operator key — one model call per transcript that is not already current.

Fence: host+origin+json — Loopback fence plus Origin check, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.

Writes state: yes

Every gist already on disk, each marked stale when its transcript has changed since it was written. Free — no model call, no transcript read.

Fence: host — Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.

item.description: The tutorial: progress, surface visits, mode, reset, manual ticks.

The tutorial + this home's progress: mode, level, marks, remaining, history.
